blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in computational social science to assign scalar scores to social and psychological constructs. However, studies use different rating scales, and whether their scores remain comparable across scale designs is understudied. To address this gap, we define and systematically investigate scale sensitivity, the variation in LLM-generated scores caused by rating scale design. We distinguish numerical sensitivity, changes in normalized scores, from semantic sensitivity, changes in score interpretation. To assess both, our experimental design crosses 2 formats (continuous vs. ordinal), 4 ranges (3, 5, 11, and 21 points), and 2 signs (signed vs. unsigned) across 3 tasks (political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity), 2 prompting strategies (zero-shot and rubric-based), and 5 LLMs. We find that changing one design element shifts normalized scores by about 0.10 on average and changes the category of roughly 20% of texts. Sensitivity is greatest for toxicity, the only unipolar construct examined. Also, rubric-based prompting does not reduce sensitivity compared with zero-shot prompting. We provide practical guidance for designing more reliable LLM-based text scoring and highlight the need for robustness checks across alternative scales.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于计算社会科学,为社会和心理构造分配分数. 然而,研究使用不同的分级表,其分数是否在尺度设计上仍然具有可比性,但研究不足. 为了弥补这一差距,我们界定并系统调查了尺度敏感性,即评级尺度设计造成的LLM生成分数的变化. 我们区分出数值灵敏度,常态分数的变化,从语义灵敏度,分数解释的变化. 为了评估这两个方面,我们的实验设计跨越了两种格式(连续对正弦),4个范围(3、5、11和21分)和2个标志(签名对未签名),涉及3个任务(政治倾斜、情绪和毒性),2个促进战略(零镜头和以面值为基础的)和5个LLM。 我们发现,改变一个设计要素的分数 平均为0.10, 并改变大约20%的文本类别。 毒性的敏感性最大,这是所检查的唯一单极结构。 另外,与零射入提示相比,基于rumric的提示不会降低灵敏度. 我们为设计更可靠的基于LLM的文本评分提供了实际指导,并强调需要在不同的尺度上进行健全的核查。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for text analysis at scale. Compared to human raters or traditional supervised models, LLMs provide strong cross-domain versatility with reduced costs and time. In computational social science, scholars use LLMs for various tasks, including political leaning identification Gilardi et al. (2023) ; Heseltine and Clemm von Hohenberg (2024) ; Törnberg (2023) , hateful or toxic context detection Hee and Lee (2025) ; Jo et al. (2024) , sentiment analysis Rathje et al. (2024) ; Ornstein et al. (2025) , and topic or framing analysis Wang et al. (2023) ; Kuang et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)越来越多地用于规模化的文本分析. 与人类测评或传统监督模型相比,LLMS提供了强大的跨域多功能,成本和时间都减少了. 在计算社会科学中,学者们将LLMs用于各种任务,包括政治倾向识别Gilardi等人(2023年),Heseltine和Clemm von Hohenberg(2024年),Törnberg(2023年),仇恨或有毒背景检测Hee和Lee(2025年),Jo等人(2024年),情绪分析Rathje等人(2024年),Ornstein等人(2025年),以及专题或框架分析Wang等人(2023年),Kuang等人(2025年).

blocks.en: Many constructs in the social sciences are better understood when measured along a continuum rather than as discrete categories Licht et al. (2025) . For example, concepts such as ideological extremity, toxicity severity, and moral emotions vary in degree rather than kind. To incorporate these nuances and gradations, a growing number of researchers prompt LLMs to generate scalar scores on numerical scales, treating model outputs as continuous or ordinal measures of underlying latent constructs Le Mens and Gallego (2025) ; Koh et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 社会科学中的许多构象如果按照连续体进行测量,而不是作为离散类别Licht等人(2025年)加以测量,则会得到更好的理解。 例如,意识形态极端、毒性严重性、道德情感等概念在程度上不同,在种类上不同。 为了纳入这些细微差别和分级,越来越多的研究人员促使LLMs在数字尺度上生成分数,将模型输出作为Lemes和Gallego(2025年)、Koh等人(2024年)和Li等人(2024年)的基本潜在构象的连续或普通计量。

blocks.zh: 图 1:评价尺度敏感性的实验设计.

blocks.en: Yet, how consistent their outputs are across different rating scales or how sensitive those outputs are to changes in scale design has received limited academic attention. Existing studies have relied on different prompts and rating scale designs that vary in both scale format and range, even when measuring the same underlying construct. For example, some studies evaluate toxicity using a continuous scale between 0 and 1 Li et al. (2024) ; Koh et al. (2024) , whereas other studies adopt Likert-type ordinal scales ranging from 1 to 5 Movva et al. (2024) . A systematic examination of how rating scale design influences LLM-generated scores is therefore essential to establish the reliability, validity, and comparability of LLM-based measurement.
blocks.zh: 然而,不同评级等级的产出如何一致,或这些产出对规模设计变化的敏感程度受到学术关注有限。 现有的研究都依赖于不同的提示和评级尺度设计,在尺度格式和范围上都有所不同,即使在测量同一个基础构造时也是如此. 例如,一些研究利用0至1李等人(2024年)的连续尺度评估毒性;Koh等人(2024年),而其他研究采用Ikrt-型正弦尺度,范围为1至5Movva等人(2024年)。 因此,系统审查评级尺度设计如何影响LLM生成的分数,对于确定LLM计量的可靠性、有效性和可比性至关重要。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we define scale sensitivity as the degree to which LLM-generated scalar outputs vary in response to changes in rating scale design. We systematically examine three design elements of the rating scale: format (continuous vs. ordinal), range (e.g., 3-, 5-, 11-, and 21-point scales), and sign (signed scales centered at 0 vs. unsigned scales containing only non-negative values). We assess scale sensitivity across tasks with different conceptual foundations (political leaning, toxicity, and sentiment), prompt designs (zero-shot vs. rubric-based), and models.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们把规模敏感性定义为LLM产生的scalar输出因评级尺度设计的变化而变化的程度. 我们系统地审查评级等级表的三个设计要素:格式(持续对正数),范围(如3-、5-、11-和21-点),以及签名(以0对0为中心、仅包含非负值的无标记等级表)。 我们评估具有不同概念基础(政治倾向、毒性和情绪)、即时设计(零射对鲁比克)和模型的任务的规模敏感性。

blocks.en: We further distinguish between two forms of scale sensitivity: numerical sensitivity and semantic sensitivity . Numerical sensitivity captures whether a model assigns different normalized scores to the same item when the rating scale changes, whereas semantic sensitivity captures whether those changes switch the substantive interpretation of the output.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步区分两种规模敏感性:数字敏感性和语义敏感性。 数值灵敏度捕捉模型在评级尺度变化时是否为同一项目分配不同的常态分数,而语义灵敏度捕捉这些变化是否切换了对输出的实质性解释.

blocks.en: Using the experimental design shown in Figure 1 , we find systematic evidence of both numerical and semantic scale sensitivity. Specifically, changing one rating scale design element shifts normalized scores by about 0.10 and changes the category of roughly one in five texts. The toxicity scoring task shows the greatest sensitivity, particularly to scale sign. Compared with zero-shot prompting, rubric-based prompting does not reduce sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 利用图1所示的实验设计,我们发现了数字和语义尺度敏感度的系统证据. 具体地说,改变一个评分表设计要素,使分数正常化大约0.10,并改变大约五分之一文本的类别。 毒性评分任务显示了最大的敏感性,特别是对标尺的敏感性。 与零镜头提示相比,基于rugric的提示不会降低灵敏度.

blocks.en: Our paper makes three key contributions. • We conceptualize and empirically characterize scale sensitivity as an underexamined source of variation in LLM-based measurement. • We demonstrate that scale sensitivity has direct implications for the comparability, replicability, and validity of LLM-scored measurements. • We provide practical guidance for more reliable LLM-based text scoring. We recommend robustness checks across alternative rating scales, choosing scales that match the structure of the construct, and assessing agreement with suitable human labels, when available, as evidence of validity.
blocks.zh: 我们的文件作出了三项重要贡献。 · 我们概念化和经验化地将规模敏感性定性为LLM计量中未得到充分研究的变异来源。 我们表明,尺度敏感性对LLM计分测量的可比性、可复制性和有效性有直接影响。 我们为更可靠的基于LLM的文本评分提供实际指导。 我们建议在不同的评级等级之间进行稳健性检查,选择与结构相符的等级,并在有适当的人类标签时评估是否同意作为有效的证据。

blocks.en: We conceptualize and empirically characterize scale sensitivity as an underexamined source of variation in LLM-based measurement.
blocks.zh: 我们从概念上和经验上将规模敏感性定性为基于LLM的测量中未得到充分研究的变异源。

blocks.en: We demonstrate that scale sensitivity has direct implications for the comparability, replicability, and validity of LLM-scored measurements.
blocks.zh: 我们表明,尺度敏感性对LLM计分测量的可比性、可复制性和有效性有直接影响。

blocks.en: We provide practical guidance for more reliable LLM-based text scoring. We recommend robustness checks across alternative rating scales, choosing scales that match the structure of the construct, and assessing agreement with suitable human labels, when available, as evidence of validity.
blocks.zh: 我们为更可靠的基于LLM的文本评分提供实际指导。 我们建议在不同的评级等级之间进行稳健性检查,选择与结构相符的等级,并在有适当的人类标签时评估是否同意作为有效的证据。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Rating Scale Design in Measurement
blocks.zh: 2.1 计量中标定尺度设计

blocks.en: Survey and psychometric research demonstrates that a rating scale design affects how humans rate the same construct. We review this evidence for the three design elements we manipulate, namely format, sign, and range.
blocks.zh: 调查和心理测量研究显示,评级尺度设计会影响人类如何评定同一结构。 我们审查我们操纵的三个设计要素,即格式、标志和范围的证据。

blocks.en: Social scientists measure scalar constructs with two broad families of rating scales. For one, attitudes, emotions, and perceptions have traditionally been measured with ordinal Likert-type scales (e.g., 1–5 or 1–7) ( Likert, 2017 ; Anastasiadou, 2011 ) , 1 1 1 Although Likert scales are often treated as interval, we regard them as ordinal because the distances between scale points are not guaranteed to be equal ( Wu and Leung, 2017 ) . . For another, computational tools increasingly assign continuous scores, including VADER sentiment scores ranging from − 1 -1 to 1 1 ( Hutto and Gilbert, 2014 ) and Perspective API toxicity scores ranging from 0 0 to 1 1 ( Jigsaw, n.d. ) . Compared with ordinal scales, continuous scales preserve more information and allow finer-grained judgments ( Treiblmaier and Filzmoser, 2011 ) . However, studies comparing the two formats have not found that either one consistently yields higher reliability or validity ( Treiblmaier and Filzmoser, 2011 ; Svensson, 2000 ) . Regardless of which format is preferable, the two formats produce different ratings of the same stimuli ( Lawless and Malone, 1986 ) .
blocks.zh: 社会科学家用两个大家族的评级尺度来衡量scalar结构. 首先,态度、情感和观念传统上是用普通的类似物型尺度(如1-5或1-7)来衡量的(Import,2017年;Anastasiadou,2011年),1-1。 1 虽然Likrt天平通常被作为间隔处理,但我们视其为平坦,因为天平点之间的距离不能保证相等(Wu and Leung, 2017). 另一种说法是,计算工具越来越多地分配连续的分数,包括VADER情绪分数从−1-1到1(Hutto和Gilbert,2014年)和Perspect API毒性分数从0到1(Jigsaw, n.d.). 与平面图相比,连续平面图保存了更多信息,并允许作出更细微的判决(Treiblmaier和Filzmoser,2011年)。 然而,比较这两种格式的研究并未发现一种格式的可靠性或有效性始终较高(Treiblmaier和Filzmoser,2011年;Svensson,2000年)。 无论哪一种格式更可取,这两种格式都产生对同一刺激的不同评级(Lawless和Malone,1986年)。

blocks.en: Rating scales differ in range, that is, the number of points they offer (e.g., 3, 5, 11, or 21 points). Changing the number of points changes the measurement properties of a scale, but findings are inconclusive on whether more points are better. Some studies suggest that adding points can improve distributional properties and internal consistency ( Leung, 2011 ; Xu and Leung, 2018 ; Chang, 1994 ) , which may in turn improve validity and reliability ( Kusmaryono et al., 2022 ) . Others find that overly fine-grained scales may reduce consistency and reliability in certain contexts ( Cai et al., 2016 ; Chang, 1994 ) .
blocks.zh: 评分比额表在幅度上有所不同,即它们提供的分数(如3,5,11,或21分). 改变点数会改变一个比例尺的测量属性,但对于更多的点数是否更好,结论并不确定. 一些研究认为,加点可以提高分布属性和内部一致性(梁,2011;徐和梁,2018;张,1994),这反过来可以提高有效性和可靠性(Kusmaryono等人,2022). 其他人认为,过分细化的比额表可能在某些情况下降低一致性和可靠性(Cai等人,2016年;Chang,1994年)。

blocks.en: A rating scale with the same number of points can be signed or unsigned. A signed scale includes negative values and is centered on 0 (e.g., − 1 -1 to 1 1 ), whereas an unsigned scale uses only non-negative values (e.g., 1 1 to 3 3 ). The sign of the scale changes how respondents interpret its endpoints. For example in an empirical study, when the same verbal endpoints were labeled − 5 -5 to + 5 +5 instead of 0 0 to 10 10 , human respondents selected the lower half of the scale less often. Negative numbers led them to interpret the low endpoint as the presence of an opposite attribute rather than the absence of the attribute ( Schwarz et al., 1991 ) . Similarly, labeling a 7-point scale − 3 -3 to + 3 +3 instead of 1 1 to 7 7 shifted responses toward the positive end ( Tourangeau et al., 2007 ) . In short, scale sign can influence both the distribution of ratings and the meaning respondents attach to scale points.
blocks.zh: 分数相同的评分表可以签名或未签名. 已签名的尺度包括负值,并以0(例如− 1 - 1 到 1 1 )为中心,而未签名的尺度只使用非负值(例如 1 1 到 3 3 ) 。 比例表的标志改变了被调查者如何解释其终点。 例如,在一项实证研究中,当相同的口头端点被标为− 5-5到+5+5而不是0-10 10时,人类被调查者选择比例尺的下半部分较少. 负数使他们将低终点解释为存在相反的属性,而不是不存在属性(Schwarz等人,1991年)。 同样,标注7分的尺度−3-3至+3+3,而不是1-1-7 7,将答复转向正端(Tourangeau等人,2007年)。 简言之,比例标志既可以影响评级的分布,也可以影响被调查者对比例点附加的意义.

blocks.en: It remains unclear whether rating scale design influences LLM-generated scores as it does human ratings. Thus, this paper systematically investigates how consistent LLM-generated scores are across rating scale designs. Because LLM outputs are sensitive to changes in prompt formatting, ordering, and instructions ( Sclar et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Guan et al., 2025 ; Zhuo et al., 2024 ) , we hold the prompt fixed within each prompting strategy and change only the rating scale it specifies so that differences in scores across rating scale conditions can be attributed to scale design. We quantify these differences as numerical and semantic sensitivity. In this context, we ask: (RQ1) To what extent do changes in rating scale format, sign, and range produce (a) numerical and (b) semantic scale sensitivity in LLM-generated outputs?
blocks.zh: 目前还不清楚评级尺度设计是否像对人评级一样影响LLM生成的分数. 因此,本文系统地调查了LLM生成的分数如何在评级尺度设计上保持一致. 由于LLM输出对快速格式化,订单和指令的改变很敏感(Sclar等人,2024年;He等人,2024年;Guan等人,2025年;Zhuo等人,2024年),我们把每个快速策略中的快速固定下来,只改变它具体规定的评分等级,这样各个评分等级条件的分数差异可以归因于尺度设计. 我们将这些差异量化为数字和语义敏感性。 在这方面,我们问:(RQ1)评级尺度格式、签名和范围的变化在多大程度上产生了(a) 数值和(b) LLM生成的语义尺度敏感性?

blocks.en: 2.2 Variances across Task, Prompting Strategy, and Model
blocks.zh: 2.2 任务、快速战略和模式之间的差异

blocks.en: We further examine whether three factors moderate scale sensitivity, namely the task, the prompting strategy, and the model.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查三个因素是否适度的对规模的敏感性,即任务、激励战略和模式。

blocks.en: We measure political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity, three constructs widely explored in computational social science ( Le Mens and Gallego, 2025 ; Robertson et al., 2023 ; Rathje et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) . Political leaning, such as positioning actors or texts along a left-right spectrum, is a social construct , grounded in political parties, agendas, elites, and symbolic meanings that are socially agreed upon Bergan (2012) ; Boudreau and MacKenzie (2014) . Sentiment is a psychological construct that reflects individuals’ affective states such as positivity or negativity Evans (2002) . Toxicity is a socio-psychological construct whose judgment depends on both social norms and expressions of anger or hostility ( Sheth et al., 2022 ; Pandita et al., 2024 ) . We note that political leaning and sentiment are bipolar constructs that range between two opposing poles (left vs. right and negative vs. positive), whereas toxicity is a unipolar construct that ranges from the absence of toxicity to its strong presence. Given these conceptual differences across tasks, we ask: (RQ2) To what extent does the task moderate (a) numerical and (b) semantic scale sensitivity?
blocks.zh: 我们衡量政治倾向、情绪和毒性,在计算社会科学中广泛探讨的三个构思(Le Mens and Gallego,2025年;Robertson等人,2023年;Rathje等人,2021年;Yu等人,2024年)。 政治倾向(如将行为者或文本定位在左翼)是一种社会结构,其根基是政党、议程、精英以及社会上同意的Bergan(2012年);Boudreau和MacKenzie(2014年)。 感性是一种心理构造,它反映了个人的情感状态,如消极或消极的埃文斯(2002年). 毒性是一种社会心理结构,其判断取决于社会规范和愤怒或敌意的表达(Sheth等人,2022年;Pandita等人,2024年)。 我们注意到,政治倾向和情绪是两极结构,介于两个对立极之间(左对右和负对正),而毒性是单极结构,从无毒性到强烈存在不等。 鉴于任务之间的这些概念差异,我们问:(RQ2)任务在多大程度上缓解(a) 数字和(b) 语义尺度敏感性?

blocks.en: The prompting strategy may also affect how stable LLM-generated scores are across rating scales. We compare two strategies that do not introduce additional confounding factors and differ in how much guidance they provide: zero-shot and rubric-based prompting strategies. Zero-shot prompting is commonly used in LLM-based text scoring ( Gilardi et al., 2023 ; Törnberg, 2023 ; Le Mens and Gallego, 2025 ) and requests a direct rating without explicit evaluation criteria. Rubric-based prompting, modeled on educational assessment, provides detailed coding guidelines for predefined dimensions of a construct. It asks the model to score each dimension and use these assessments to determine a final rating. Rubrics have been shown to improve consistency in LLM-based scoring ( Hashemi et al., 2024 ; Eltanbouly et al., 2025 ; Sharma et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , but whether they also stabilize scores across rating scales is unknown. If scale sensitivity stems from underspecified evaluation criteria, explicit rubrics should reduce it. If it stems from how models map judgments onto numerical scales, it should persist regardless of prompting strategy. We thus ask: (RQ3) To what extent does the prompting strategy (zero-shot vs. rubric-based) moderate (a) numerical and (b) semantic scale sensitivity?
blocks.zh: 催化策略还可能影响LLM生成的分数在分级表中的稳定性. 我们比较了两个没有引入更多混淆因素的战略,在它们提供多少指导方面有所不同:零镜头和基于主题的激励战略。 零镜头提示法在基于LLM的文本评分(Gilardi等人,2023年;Törnberg,2023年;Le Mens and Gallego,2025年)中常用,并要求在没有明确评价标准的情况下直接评分. 基于Rubric的催化,以教育评估为模型,为预定义的构造维度提供了详细的编码准则. 它要求模型给每个维度打分,并利用这些评估来确定最后的评分. Rubrics已证明可以提高基于LLM的评分的一致性(Hashim等人,2024年;Eltanbouly等人,2025年;Sharma等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年),但它们是否也稳定了各评级等级的分数,尚不得而知。 如果标码灵敏度来源于规格不足的评价标准,则清晰的标点应降低标码. 如果它源于模型如何将判断映射到数字尺度上,那么无论采取什么迅速的战略,它都应该持续下去。 因此,我们问:(RQ3)促动战略(零射对以红宝石为基础的)中度(a) 数值和(b) 语义尺度敏感度有多大?

blocks.en: Model selection has become a consequential methodological choice in computational social science. Models differ in training data, optimization objectives, and alignment procedures, and most offer limited transparency into how they represent semantic judgments internally ( Kristensen-McLachlan et al., 2025 ) . Considering these differences, we ask: (RQ4) To what extent does the choice of LLM moderate (a) numerical and (b) semantic scale sensitivity?
blocks.zh: 模型选择已成为计算社会科学中一个相应的方法选择. 模式在培训数据、优化目标和协调程序方面各不相同,大多数模式在如何代表内部语义判断方面的透明度有限(Kristensen-McLachlan等人,2025年)。 考虑到这些差异,我们问:(RQ4)LLM的选择在多大程度上是中度的(a)数字和(b)语义尺度敏感性?

blocks.en: Additionally, we test which measurement design choices most strongly affect the sensitivity of LLM-generated scores by asking: (RQ5) How much of the variation in (a) numerical and (b) semantic scale sensitivity is explained by scale design, task, prompting strategy, and model?
blocks.zh: 此外,我们通过询问(RQ5),测试哪些测量设计选择对LLM生成的分数的敏感性影响最大的是:(a) 数值和(b) 语义尺度敏感性中有多少变化是由尺度设计、任务、激励策略和模型解释的?

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 3 实验设计

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We use three human-labeled datasets, one for each task (i.e., political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity; See Table 1 ). See Appendix A for details.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个人类标记的数据集,每个任务一个(即政治倾向、情绪和毒性;见表1)。 见附录 详细情况 A.

blocks.en: 3.2 Rating Scale Conditions
blocks.zh: 3.2 评级尺度条件

blocks.en: We vary three rating scale design elements. Response format is continuous (any real number within the range) or ordinal (integers only). Scale range is 3, 5, 11, or 21 points. Scale sign is signed (centered on 0) or unsigned (non-negative values only). Each unique combination of these elements defines a rating scale condition, yielding 16 conditions in total (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们有三种等级等级设计要素 反应格式是连续的(范围内的任何实数)或正弦的(仅插入). 尺度范围为3,5,11,或21分. 缩放符号为签名(以0为中心)或未签名(仅非负值). 这些要素的每一个独特的组合都确定了评级等级条件,总共产生了16个条件(表2)。

blocks.en: 3.4 Prompts
blocks.zh: 3.4 提示

blocks.en: We compared zero-shot and rubric-based prompting. The two prompts share the task description, scale instruction, core scoring instructions, and input text. The rubric-based prompt adds the rubric, instructions for scoring each dimension, and an output field for each dimension. Details about the prompts are presented in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了零镜头和基于数字的提示。 两个提示共享任务描述,尺度指令,核心评分指令,以及输入文本. 基于面额的提示添加了面额,每个尺寸的评分指令,以及每个尺寸的输出字段. 关于提示的细节见附录B。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Zero-Shot Prompt
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 零热速率

blocks.en: The zero-shot prompt asks the model to evaluate the target construct in the text and to return a JSON object containing a single final score on the requested scale.
blocks.zh: 零射速率要求模型评价文本中的目标构造,并返回一个包含一个在请求的尺度上唯一的最终分数的JSON对象.

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Rubric-Based Prompt
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 基于Rubric的快速

blocks.en: The rubric-based prompt additionally includes a task-specific rubric that decomposes each construct (i.e., political leaning, sentiment, and toxicity) into conceptually relevant dimensions (Table 3 ). The rubrics were tailored to each task and to each dataset’s unit of analysis, and grounded in the relevant literature. The model is asked to score every dimension on the requested scale and then to assign a single final score as a holistic judgment of the text as a whole. This design is intended to make the scoring process more structured.
blocks.zh: 以标题为基础的提示还包括将每个构件(即政治倾斜、情绪和毒性)分解为概念相关维度的特定任务标题(表3)。 标题是根据每项任务和每个数据集的分析单位量身定做的,并以有关文献为依据。 该模型被要求在要求的尺度上给每个维度打分,然后指定一个单一的最终分数作为对整个文本的整体判断. 这种设计旨在使评分过程更有条理.

blocks.en: Under both prompting strategies, we analyze only the final score, so that the two prompts are compared on the same output.
blocks.zh: 在这两个促动策略下,我们只分析最终的得分,这样两个促动就在同一输出上进行比较.

blocks.en: 3.5 Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 3.5 评价框架

blocks.en: We measure scale sensitivity by comparing the scores that the same model gives to the same text under two rating scale conditions that differ in exactly one design element. This section describes how we calculate numerical and semantic sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较同一模型在两个评级尺度条件下给同一文本的分数来衡量尺度敏感性,这两个条件在完全一个设计要素上是不同的. 本节介绍我们如何计算数值和语义敏感性。

Let r i , s r_{i,s} denote the raw score assigned to item i i on scale s s , and let a s a_{s} and b s b_{s} denote the scale’s specified minimum and maximum values. The normalized score is z i , s = r i , s − a s b s − a s ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] . z_{i,s}=\frac{r_{i,s}-a_{s}}{b_{s}-a_{s}}\in[0,1]. (1)

blocks.en: 3.5.2 Minimal Scale Pairs
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 最小比例对等

blocks.en: The 16 rating scale conditions cross response format (continuous, ordinal), scale range (3, 5, 11, or 21 points) and scale sign (signed, unsigned). 2 2 2 Unsigned 3- and 5-point scales run from 1 to N N and unsigned 11- and 21-point scales from 0 to N N , so that the midpoint is attainable. To isolate sensitivity to each design element, we compare only minimal pairs , defined as two rating scale conditions that differ in one design element while the other two remain fixed. For example, comparing a continuous signed 5-point scale with an ordinal signed 5-point scale isolates sensitivity to response format because both scales have the same sign and range. This procedure leads to 40 minimal pairs. Eight pairs differ only in format, 24 differ only in range, and eight differ only in sign. We assess sensitivity to each design element using the pairs that differ in that element.

blocks.en: 3.5.5 Analytical Framework
blocks.zh: 3.5.5 分析框架

blocks.en: We compute S ​ S MAE SS_{\mathrm{MAE}} and S ​ S switch SS_{\mathrm{switch}} for each minimal pair within every combination of task, prompting strategy, and model. This yields 1,200 estimates per metric across 3 tasks, 2 prompting strategies, 5 models, and 40 minimal pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们计算S S MAE SS SS_{\mathrm{MAE}} 和 S 切换 SS_{\mathrm{switch}} 在任务,提示策略,和模型的每一个组合中,每个最小对. 这样,在3项任务、2项推动战略、5项模型和40项最小对任务中,每公吨得到1 200个估计数。

blocks.en: To answer RQ1, we average the estimates from the minimal pairs that change each design element, separately for format, range, and sign. We report these averages for numerical sensitivity, S ​ S MAE SS_{\mathrm{MAE}} (RQ1a), and for semantic sensitivity, S ​ S switch SS_{\mathrm{switch}} (RQ1b). Each task, prompting strategy, model, and pair receives equal weight. We additionally analyze whether sensitivity to one design element depends on the values of the other two elements. For example, we calculate range sensitivity separately on ordinal and on continuous scales (i.e., format), and format sensitivity separately on scales with 3, 5, 11, and 21 points (i.e., range).
blocks.zh: 为了回答RQ1,我们从改变每个设计元素的最小对数中,分别对格式,范围,和签名进行估计. 我们报告这些平均值用于数值敏感度,S S MAE SS_{\mathrm{MAE}}(RQ1a),以及语义敏感度,S 切换 SS_{\mathrm{switch}}(RQ1b). 每个任务,促动策略,模型,和对子都得到同等的重量. 我们还分析了对一个设计要素的敏感性是否取决于另外两个要素的值。 例如,我们在正弦和连续尺度(即格式)上分别计算范围敏感性,在比例尺上分别计算格式敏感性,分数为3,5,11和21分(即范围).

blocks.en: To test RQ2 to RQ4, we fit a weighted least squares (WLS) regression of the 1,200 estimates on the design element changed (format, range, or sign), task, prompting strategy, and model. We include interactions between the design element changed and each of the other three factors. We fit the model separately for numerical sensitivity ( S ​ S MAE SS_{\mathrm{MAE}} ) and semantic sensitivity ( S ​ S switch SS_{\mathrm{switch}} ).
blocks.zh: 为了测试RQ2到RQ4,我们把1200个估算值的加权最小方块(WLS)回归到已改变的设计元素(格式、范围或标志)、任务、提示策略和模型上。 我们包括改变的设计要素与其他三个因素的相互作用。 我们分别将模型用于数值灵敏度(S S MAE SS_{\mathrm{MAE})和语义灵敏度(S S 切换 SS_{\mathrm{switch}).

blocks.en: We estimate uncertainty using an item bootstrap with 2,000 resamples. In each resample, we sample texts with replacement within each task and use the same sampled texts across all models, prompting strategies, and scale pairs. We then recompute every statistic and obtain 95% confidence intervals from the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the bootstrap estimates. Because every 95% confidence interval lies within 0.01 of its estimate, we report point estimates in section 4 and give intervals in the figures and tables.
blocks.zh: 我们用2 000个复标的靴子来估计不确定性。 在每个复刻中,我们在每个任务中都用替换的文本进行样本,并在所有模型中使用相同的样本文本,提示策略,以及比例对. 然后我们重新计算每一份统计, 得到95%的置信间隔 从2.5和97.5百分位数的靴子估计。 由于95%的置信间隔都在估计值的0.01之内,我们在第4节中报告点数估计数,并在数字和表格中给出间隔。

blocks.en: Lastly, we explore how much of the variation in sensitivity each factor explains to answer RQ5. We extend the regression to all interactions between pairs of design variables and decompose the variance of the 1,200 estimates into the share attributable to each factor, η 2 \eta^{2} .

blocks.en: Across all three design elements, numerical sensitivity amounts to approximately one tenth of the normalized scale, and semantic sensitivity indicates that one in five texts receives a different category when the scale design changes. blocks.en: We additionally report whether sensitivity to one design element depends on the values of the other two elements, for example whether switching from a continuous to an ordinal format matters more on a 3-point scale than on a 21-point scale (see Figure 3 ). We found three notable patterns. First, finer scales reduce numerical but not semantic sensitivity to format . Switching formats moves scores by 0.146 (95% CI [0.144, 0.147]) on 3-point scales but by 0.078 ([0.077, 0.078]) on 21-point scales, whereas the share of texts that change category stays between 18.2% and 20.1% at every scale length. Second, ordinal scales amplify range changes, shifting scores by 0.128 ([0.126, 0.129]) compared with 0.068 ([0.067, 0.069]) on continuous scales and changing the category of 21.5% compared with 14.9% of texts. Third, continuous scales amplify sign changes, which alter the category of 24.4% ([24.1%, 24.7%]) of texts on continuous scales but 16.3% ([16.1%, 16.6%]) on ordinal scales.
blocks.zh: 我们还报告,对一个设计要素的敏感性是否取决于另外两个要素的值,例如从连续格式转换为普通格式是否比对21点的尺度更重要(见图3)。 我们发现了三种明显的模式。 首先,更细的缩放减小了对格式的语义敏感性。 切换格式在3个比例表上移动得分0.146(95% CI [0.144,0.147]),而在21个比例表上移动得分0.078([0.077,0.078]),而改变类别文本的比例在每个比例表长度上停留在18.2%至20.1%之间. 第二,平面尺度扩大范围变化,在连续的尺度上比0.068([0.067,0.069])移动得分0.128([0.126,0.129]),并改变21.5%的类别,而14.9%的文本. 第三,连续天平扩展了标志变化,改变了24.4%([24.1%,24.7%)的连续天平文本类别,但改变16.3%([16.1%,16.6%)的正弦天平。

blocks.en: 4.2 Moderation by Task, Prompting Strategy, and Model
blocks.zh: 4.2 按任务、迅速战略和模式分列的调整

blocks.en: Figure 5: Share of the variation in scale sensitivity explained by each factor. Black lines are 95% item bootstrap intervals. The full decomposition is reported in Table 7 in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 图5:每个因素所解释的尺度敏感度变化的比例。 黑线是95%的靴子间隔。 完整的分解情况见附录F表7。

blocks.en: Concerning RQ2, scale sensitivity depends strongly on the task. Toxicity is the most sensitive, with 29 to 40 % of texts changing category depending on the design element, compared with 13 to 15 % for political leaning and 8 to 10 % for sentiment. Numerical sensitivity follows the same order. The task also changes which design element produces the greatest sensitivity. For political leaning and sentiment, changes in the three design elements have similar effects, whereas for toxicity, changing the sign is the most sensitive. Relative to format changes, sign changes move 8.0 % points more toxicity texts across categories than political leaning texts (Table 6 ). Toxicity is the only unipolar construct in our design, ranging from absence to strong presence rather than between two opposing poles. This may explain why it reacts so strongly to signed scales, which place negative numbers at the low end of the scale, although with a single unipolar task we cannot rule out other differences between the tasks.
blocks.zh: 关于RQ2,规模敏感性在很大程度上取决于任务。 毒性是最敏感的,29%至40%的文本根据设计要素而改变类别,而政治倾向的比例为13%至15%,感情水平为8%至10%。 数值灵敏度遵循相同的顺序. 这项任务还改变了设计要素产生最大敏感性的因素。 就政治倾向和情绪而言,三个设计要素的改变具有类似效果,而就毒性而言,改变标志是最敏感的。 相对于格式变化,签名变化比政治倾向文本(表6)在类别中分数多8.0%。 毒性是我们设计中唯一的单极结构,从无到强存在不等,而不是介于两个对立极之间。 这或许可以解释为什么它会如此强烈地对所签的天平作出反应,它把负数放在天平的低端,虽然单极任务不能排除任务之间的其他差异.

blocks.en: In contrast, the prompting strategy has almost no effect (RQ3). For every design element, sensitivity under rubric prompting is within 0.007 of sensitivity under zero-shot prompting, and all interaction terms are 0.006 or smaller (Table 6 ). The small differences that appear run in opposite directions across tasks. Rubrics slightly increase semantic sensitivity for political leaning and sentiment and slightly decrease it for toxicity. That is, adding explicit evaluation criteria does not make scores more stable to the rating scale.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,催化战略几乎没有效果(RQ3)。 对于每个设计元素,标点提示下的灵敏度在零发提示下的灵敏度0.007以内,所有相互作用术语均为0.006或更小(表6 ). 不同任务之间出现的小差异是相反的。 Rubrics略微提高了政治倾向和情绪的语义敏感性,略微降低了其毒性. 也就是说,增加明确的评价标准并不能使评分比评级更加稳定。

blocks.en: For RQ4, model choice affects scale sensitivity more than prompting strategy but much less than task. All five models are sensitive to changes in all three design elements in the same way (see Figure 4 ). Qwen3.8 27B is the most sensitive model and Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite the least sensitive. Within each model, sensitivity to the three design elements differs by at most five percentage points.
blocks.zh: 就RQ4而言,模型选择对尺度敏感度的影响大于激发策略,但远低于任务. 所有五个型号都以同样的方式对三个设计元素的变化敏感(见图4). Quen3.8. 27B是最敏感的模型,双子座3.5 Flash Lite是最不敏感的. 在每个模型中,对三个设计要素的敏感度在最多5个百分点时不同.

blocks.en: 4.3 Relative Importance of Each Design Choice
blocks.zh: 4.3 每种设计选择的相对重要性

blocks.en: Regarding RQ5, the variance decomposition places all factors on a common scale (Figure 5 ) and shows that scale design and the task explain different aspects of sensitivity. Scale design explains the largest share of numerical sensitivity (40.3%) but only 8.9% of semantic sensitivity. The task explains 29.7% of numerical sensitivity and 58.9% of semantic sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 关于RQ5, 差异分解将所有因素置于一个共同的尺度上(图5),并表明尺度设计和任务解释了敏感度的不同方面。 缩放设计解释了数值灵敏度的最大比例(40.3%),但只有8.9%的语义灵敏度. 该任务解释了29.7%的数值灵敏度和58.9%的语义灵敏度.

blocks.en: The model and the prompting strategy explain little of either. The model accounts for 2.6% of numerical and 1.3% of semantic variation, and the prompting strategy for less than 0.1%. Their interactions with scale design add 3.4 to 4.1% for the model and 0.2 to 0.3% for the prompting strategy. The second largest source of semantic variation is instead the interaction between scale design and task (16.0%), which captures combinations such as signed scales for toxicity.
blocks.zh: 模式和激励战略对两者都没有什么解释。 该模型占数值变化的2.6%,占语义变化的1.3%,促动策略占不到0.1%. 它们与规模设计的相互作用使模型增加3.4%至4.1%,使促进策略增加0.2%至0.3%。 语义变异的第二大来源是比例尺设计与任务(16.0%)之间的相互作用,它捕捉到各种组合,如签署毒性比例尺.

blocks.en: 4.4 Additional Analyses
blocks.zh: 4.4 其他分析

blocks.en: Moreover, we conduct two supplemental analyses. First, we repeat all rating scale conditions using the three open models, each at three reasoning levels (Appendix E.1 ). Notably, we find that higher reasoning effort is associated with small reductions in scale sensitivity. Second, we assess agreement between LLM-generated scores and the human labels provided in each dataset (Appendix E.2 ). Further details are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 此外,我们进行了两项补充分析。 首先,我们重复所有使用三个开放模型的评级尺度条件,每个条件在三个推理层次(附录E.1 ). 值得注意的是,我们发现,更高的推理努力与规模敏感性小幅降低有关。 其次,我们评估LLM生成的分数与每个数据集提供的人类标签(附录E.2 )之间的协议. 详见附录E。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This study investigates the extent to which LLM-generated scores remain consistent when only the rating scale design changes. Using an experimental design with 3 tasks, 2 prompting strategies, and 5 models, we find that changing scale format, range, or sign shifts normalized scores by about 0.10 on average and changes the category of roughly 20% of texts. Toxicity, the only unipolar construct examined, is most sensitive, particularly to scale sign. Rubric-based prompting does not reduce sensitivity relative to zero-shot prompting, and model choice has a modest effect.
blocks.zh: 本研究调查了LLM生成的分数在只有评分等级设计改变时保持一致性的程度. 我们用一个实验设计 3项任务,2项激励策略,以及5个模型, 我们发现, 改变比例表格式, 范围, 或签名转换的分数 平均是0.10, 并改变大约20%的文本类别。 毒性是所检查的唯一单极结构,最敏感,特别是对标度。 基于Rubric的提示不会降低相对于零射的提示的灵敏度,模型选择效果不大.

blocks.en: Our findings indicate that rating scale design is a measurement decision that affects LLM-generated scores. We provide practical suggestions for future researchers.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,评级等级设计是影响LLM生成的分数的计量决定. 我们向未来的研究人员提出切实可行的建议。

blocks.en: First, we encourage researchers to test whether their main findings hold under at least one alternative rating scale. These robustness checks are essential for supporting the replicability and reliability of LLM-based measurement.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们鼓励研究者测试他们的主要结论是否至少有一个替代性评级等级。 这些强性检查对于支持LLM测量的可复制性和可靠性至关重要。

blocks.en:
Next, the numbers on the scale should match what the construct measures. For example, a unipolar construct such as toxicity ranges from absence to high intensity, so negative values on the rating scale may be difficult to interpret. In our experiments, models appeared to treat 0 as “not toxic” on signed scales, assigning substantially more texts to the high-toxicity category than on unsigned scales. Therefore,
We recommend unsigned scales for unipolar constructs, with the lowest endpoint representing the absence of the attribute.
blocks.zh:
接下来,比额表上的数字应该与构造措施相匹配。 例如,毒性等单极构象从无到高强度不等,因此评级尺度上的负值可能难以解释. 在我们的实验中,模型似乎将0作为在签名的标尺上的“无毒性”处理,将大量文字分配给高毒性类别,而不是未签名的标尺。 因此,
我们建议对单极结构采用未署名的尺度,最低的终点代表没有属性。

blocks.en:
Also, researchers should consider evidence of validity when choosing a rating scale. When suitable human labels are available, they can compare scores across alternative scales with these labels to inform their choice. Ideally, the labels should come from trained annotators following coding guidelines aligned with the study’s goals. Agreement with these labels shows evidence of validity. When suitable reference labels are unavailable, as may often be the case for many social constructs, robustness checks across alternative scales become especially important for assessing the stability of the findings.
In short, careful scale design, robustness checks, and validation are needed to support more reliable use of LLM-generated scores. Our findings highlight the importance of these practices when using LLMs to complement human annotation in future studies.
blocks.zh:
此外,研究人员在选择评级表时应考虑有效性的证据。 当有合适的人类标签时,他们可以将不同替代尺度的分数与这些标签进行比较,以告知他们的选择. 理想的情况是,标签应来自经过培训的注释员,他们遵循与研究目标相一致的编码准则。 与这些标签的协议表明有效性的证据。 在缺乏适当的参考标签时,许多社会结构往往会出现这种情况,不同尺度的强健性检查对于评估调查结果的稳定性尤为重要。
简而言之,需要谨慎的尺度设计,稳健性检查和验证,以支持更可靠地使用LLM生成的分数. 我们的研究结果强调,在今后的研究中,在使用法学硕士作为人类注释的补充时,这些做法非常重要。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We acknowledge the following limitations. First, the generalizability of our findings is limited by the tasks and datasets examined. Future research is welcome to test whether the findings extend to broader cultural contexts, languages other than English, and additional tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们承认以下局限性。 第一,我们的调查结果的普遍性受到所审查的任务和数据集的限制。 未来的研究是值得欢迎的,以检验研究结果是否扩展到更广泛的文化背景、英语以外的语言以及额外的任务。

blocks.en: Also, we compared only two prompting approaches: zero-shot and rubric-based. We did not include few-shot, chain-of-thought (CoT), or chain-of-verification (CoVe) prompting because these strategies introduce additional factors, such as the selection and ordering of demonstrations or intermediate reasoning steps, that could confound the comparison. Moreover, CoT has shown limited gains on subjective tasks ( Chochlakis et al., 2024 ) , while CoVe is designed to verify factual claims ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ) , making its applicability less clear for constructs that lack verifiable ground truth. We leave the evaluation of these strategies to future work.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们只比较了两种催化方法:零射法和鲁比克法。 我们没有包括几枪、思维链(CoT)或核查链(CoVe),因为这些战略引入了其他因素,例如选择和命令示威或中间推理步骤,可能混淆比较。 此外,CoT在主观任务上显示的收获有限(Chochlakis等人,2024年),而CoVe旨在核实事实性的说法(Dhuliawala等人,2024年),使得它对于缺乏可核实的地面真实性的构造的适用性不那么明确. 我们把这些战略的评估留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Statement on the Use of AI Assistants
blocks.zh: 关于使用人工智能助理的说明

blocks.en: We disclose that we used generative AI for proofreading and grammar checking with the prompt: “Edit grammar errors. Avoid being verbose or lengthy, and do not paraphrase much from the original sentences.” We also used GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, with GPT-5-mini where available, for coding assistance. The human authors reviewed the AI-generated suggestions and made the final edits.
blocks.zh: 我们披露,我们使用基因AI进行校对和语法检查,即“编辑语法错误”。 避免动词或冗长,不从原句中作太多解释。” 我们还在Visual Studio代码中使用了GitHub Copilot,在有GPT-5-mini的情况下,用于编码协助. 人类作者回顾了AI产生的建议,并进行了最终编辑.

blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集细节

blocks.en: We used publicly available datasets consistently with their intended use.
blocks.zh: 我们使用公开的数据集,与预定用途一致。

blocks.en: A.1 Political Leaning
blocks.zh: A.1 政治倾斜

blocks.en: For political leaning, we used the MBIC (Media Bias Annotation Dataset) 3 3 3 https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/timospinde/mbic-a-media-bias-annotation-dataset/data , CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 Spinde et al. (2021) . MBIC contains 1,700 sentences sampled from approximately 1,000 U.S. news articles. Ten crowdworkers annotated each sentence for media bias and opinion. The left, center, and right labels indicate the political leaning of the outlet that published the article, based on AllSides and Ad Fontes Media ratings. We used all 1,700 sentences in our analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了在政治上倾斜,我们使用了MBIC(Media Bias Annotation Dataset)3 3 https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/timospinde/mbic-a-media-bias-annotation-dataset/data,CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 Spinde等人(2021年)。 MBIC包含从约1000篇美国新闻文章中抽取的1700句. 10名群众工作者以媒体偏见和观点为每个句子注解. 左,中,右标签表示发表该文章的外卖的政治倾向,基于AllSides和Ad Fontes媒体的收视率. 我们在分析中用了所有1700句

blocks.en: A.2 Sentiment
blocks.zh: A.2 危险

blocks.en: For sentiment, we used the publicly available annotated dataset published by VADER (Valence Aware Dictionary and sEntiment Reasoner) 4 4 4 https://github.com/cjhutto/vaderSentiment , MIT License , a lexicon- and rule-based sentiment analysis tool Hutto and Gilbert (2014) . Specifically, we used the movie review subset, which includes 10,605 Rotten Tomatoes reviews labeled by 20 independent human raters on a continuous scale from − 4 -4 (negative) to 4 4 (positive). From this dataset, we sampled 5,000 reviews for the test set.
blocks.zh: 对于情感,我们使用由VADER(Valence Agender Dictionary and sintiment Reasoner)出版的公开附加说明的数据集 4 4 4 https://github.com/cjhutto/vaderSentiment,麻省理工学院 Hutto和Gilbert (2014)。 具体地说,我们使用了电影评论子集,其中包括10,605份罗腾番茄评论,由20位独立的人评分者连续标注为−4-4(负数)到4-4(正数). 从这个数据集中,我们为测试集抽样了5,000份评论.

blocks.en: A.3 Toxicity
blocks.zh: A.3 毒性

blocks.en: For toxicity, we used the dataset from the Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification competition 5 5 5 https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/jigsaw-unintended-bias-in-toxicity-classification , CC0 cjadams et al. (2019) . The training set of this dataset contains 1,804,874 comments from the Civil Comments platform, with aggregated human toxicity scores ranging from 0 to 1. Because the dataset was designed to measure toxicity in text, it may contain offensive language. Each toxicity score reflects ratings from multiple human annotators. From this dataset, we sampled 5,000 comments for the test set.
blocks.zh: 关于毒性,我们使用了Jigsaw Unintented Bias在毒性分类竞赛中的数据集 5 5 5 https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/jigsaw-unintented-bias-in-毒性分类(2019年)。 本数据集的培训集包含来自Civil Comments平台的1,804,874条评论,人类毒性的总分从0到1. 由于数据集是用来测量文本中的毒性的,因此可能含有攻击性语言. 每个毒性分数都反映了多个人类注释者的评级. 从这个数据集,我们为测试集抽样了5000条评论.

blocks.en: B.1 Zero-Shot Prompt
blocks.zh: B.1 零热速率

The sentiment and toxicity prompts follow the same structure but use task-specific descriptions, text types (movie reviews for sentiment and online text for toxicity), and scale interpretation guidance under # Scale . The toxicity prompt adjusts the scoring instructions to reflect its unipolar nature, assigning the lowest score when a text shows no toxicity and a middle score when toxicity is present but unclear. Greater distance from the lowest score indicates greater toxicity.

blocks.zh: 图6:政治倾斜零射速率.

blocks.en: B.2 Rubric-Based Prompt
blocks.zh: B.2 基于Rubric的提示

blocks.en: The rubric-based prompt extends the zero-shot prompt with the additions shown in Figure 7 . These include a # Marking Rubric section after the scale section, three additional instructions under # Scoring Instructions , and a separate output key for each rubric dimension. Table 3 presents a condensed version of the rubric for each task.
blocks.zh: 基于 rubric 的提示以图 7 所示的添加扩展了 0 shot 提示 。 其中包括在比例尺部分之后的#标记Rubric部分,在#Scoring Directorings下增加三个指令,以及每个路标尺寸的单独输出密钥. 表3列出每项任务的缩略语。

blocks.en: For each task, we first defined the construct and its endpoints, then identified relevant dimensions in established research, codebooks, and annotation frameworks.
blocks.zh: 对于每一项任务,我们首先界定了构造及其终点,然后确定了既定研究、编码本和注释框架中的相关层面。

blocks.en: We drew on multidimensional accounts of ideology that distinguish economic and social attitudes ( Treier and Hillygus, 2009 ; Feldman and Johnston, 2014 ) . The Manifesto Project codebook ( Volkens et al., 2021 ) provides policy categories covering economic intervention, welfare, traditional morality, civil liberties, law and order, and social groups. We adapted these categories to U.S. news text and organized them into economic policy, social and cultural values, government authority, and group-based equality. We also included explicit support for or criticism of political actors as partisan cues, yielding the five dimensions in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们借鉴了区分经济和社会态度的多元意识形态(Treier和Hillygus,2009年;Feldman和Johnston,2014年)。 《宣言》项目法典(Volkens等人,2021年)规定了涉及经济干预、福利、传统道德、公民自由、法律和秩序以及社会群体的政策类别。 我们把这些类别改编成美国新闻文本,并将其组织成经济政策、社会和文化价值观、政府权威和基于团体的平等。 我们还明确支持或批评政治行为者作为党派的暗示,从而产生了表3中的五个层面。

blocks.en: We referred to distinctions between sentiment polarity, subjectivity, and degrees of evaluation ( Pang and Lee, 2008 ) , along with VADER’s treatment of sentiment intensity ( Hutto and Gilbert, 2014 ) . We adapted these ideas to movie reviews through content evaluation, emotional tone, language intensity, and recommendation signals. The latter captures whether the reviewer encourages or discourages watching the film, complementing the review’s evaluative language.
blocks.zh: 以及VADER对情绪强度的处理(Hutto和Gilbert, 2014年)。 我们通过内容评价、情绪基调、语言强度和建议信号,将这些想法改编成电影评论。 后者捕捉审查者是否鼓励或劝阻观看影片,补充审查的评价语言。

blocks.en: We adapted the attribute definitions in Jigsaw’s Perspective API documentation ( Jigsaw, n.d. ) . Hate and harassment combines criteria from toxicity and severe toxicity, while identity attack, insult, profanity, and threat correspond to the API’s named attributes. We translated these definitions into evidence of increasing toxicity, with absence of the attribute at the low end.
blocks.zh: 我们修改了Jigsaw的Perspect API文档(Jigsaw, n.d.)中的属性定义。 仇恨和骚扰结合了毒性和严重毒性的标准,而身份攻击、侮辱、亵渎和威胁则符合API的特征。 我们把这些定义转化为毒性增加的证据,在低端没有属性。

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the distributions of LLM-generated scores. Figure 8 shows the cumulative distributions of normalized scores, with the human labels provided in each dataset shown as reference distributions . Yet, we do not treat these labels as ground truth for the following reasons. First, the coding instructions followed by human annotators are not fully documented and may differ from our scoring criteria. Second, the political leaning labels are categorical, which limits direct comparison with our scalar scores. Third, this study focuses on the consistency of LLM-generated scores across rating scales rather than agreement between LLMs and human annotators. We include the human labels only to provide context for the observed score distributions.
blocks.zh: 本节叙述LLM生成的分数的分布. 图8显示归一分数的累计分布,每个数据集提供的人类标签显示为参考分布. 然而,出于以下原因,我们不把这些标签视为基本真理。 首先,人类注释者所遵循的编码指示没有得到充分的记载,可能不同于我们的评分标准. 第二,政治倾向的标签是绝对的,这限制了与我们的分数的直接比较。 第三,本研究的重点是不同评级等级的LLM生成的分数的一致性,而不是LLMs与人类注释者之间的一致. 我们加入人类标签只是为了为观测到的分数分布提供上下文.

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows the proportion of texts categorized into low, middle, and high groups used to compute S ​ S switch SS_{\mathrm{switch}} .
blocks.zh: 图9显示用于计算SS切换SS_{\mathrm{switch}}的文本分为低,中,高组的比例.

blocks.en: We observe distinct score distributions across tasks. Political leaning scores concentrate heavily in the middle category (44%–67% of texts, yet depending on the scale). Sentiment scores show a polarized distribution, with most texts falling into either the low (39%–48%) or high (32%–44%) category, and only 8%–27% in the middle. Toxicity scores vary highly depending on rating scales. On continuous signed scales, 47%–52% of texts fall in the high category, compared to only 12%–22% on continuous unsigned scales. This shift suggests that when a scale is centered on zero, models tend to treat 0—rather than the lowest endpoint—as the threshold for not toxic .
blocks.zh: 我们观察到不同任务的分数分布明显。 政治倾斜分数主要集中于中间类别(44-%-67%的文本,但取决于比例)。 感知分数显示分布两极化,大多数文本都属于低(39%–48%)或高(32%–44%)类,中间只有8%–27%. 毒性分数因评级等级而异。 在连续签署的比额表中,47+=52%的文本属于高类别,而在连续未签署的比额表中,只有12+=22%。 这种转变表明,当一个尺度以零为中心时,模型往往将0而不是最低终点作为无毒性的阈值。

blocks.en: When comparing with human labels, sentiment scores are closest to the human labels, although models use the middle category somewhat less often. Political leaning scores depart most clearly, as models place 44% to 67% of texts in the middle category compared with 19% for the human labels. Toxicity categories vary most across scales, with the share of texts in the high category ranging from 8% to 52% compared with 43% for the human labels. Model scores also concentrate on particular values such as the scale midpoint and whole numbers, which appears as vertical steps in Figure 8 .
blocks.zh: 在与人类标签进行比较时,情绪分数最接近人类标签,尽管模型使用中间类的频率略低. 政治倾向的得分差得最明显,因为模型将44%至67%的文本置于中间类别,而人类标语则占19%。 毒性类别在尺度上差异最大,高类别中文本的比例从8%到52%不等,而人类标签的比例为43%。 模型分数还集中在特定值上,如比例尺中点和整数,在图8中显示为垂直步骤.

blocks.en: E.1 Reasoning Effort
blocks.zh: E.1 努力的理由

blocks.en: The main analyses run every model at its lowest reasoning level. To test whether more reasoning reduces scale sensitivity, we repeat all 16 rating scale conditions with the three open models at three reasoning levels each, namely low , medium , and xhigh for Qwen3.8 27B, and low , high , and max for DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash. Because the models name their levels differently, we compare them by their rank within each model (lowest, middle, highest). Sensitivity is calculated as in the main analyses.
blocks.zh: 主分析以最低推理水平运行每个模型. 为了测试更多的推理是否降低尺度灵敏度,我们重复了所有16个评级尺度条件,三个开放模型各有3个推理级别,即:低,中,和x高为Quen3.8 27B,低,高,和最大为DeepSeek V4 Flash和GLM 5.3 Flash. 由于模型的级别命名不同,我们按每个模型(最低,中,最高)的级别来比较. 敏感性按主要分析计算。

blocks.en: Figure 10 shows the results. Interestingly, more reasoning lowers numerical sensitivity for changes in all three design elements, but only slightly. From the lowest to the highest level, S ​ S MAE SS_{\mathrm{MAE}} falls by 0.009 for format, 0.006 for range, and 0.016 for sign, averaged over the three models. Semantic sensitivity falls by 1.1 percentage points for format and 2.6 points for sign, and does not change for range (the 95% interval includes zero). The models also differ in direction. For Qwen3.8 27B, the share of texts that change category under a range change rises from 19.1% to 22.0%. Even at the highest level, sensitivity remains close to the values in Section 4 , so more reasoning does not remove scale sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 图10显示了结果。 有趣的是,更多的推理降低了所有三个设计元素变化的数值灵敏度,但只是略微. 从最低到最高,S S MAE SSQMTHRM{MAE}在格式上降为0.009,在范围上降为0.006,在标志上降为0.016,在三种模型上均值. 语义敏感度在格式上下降了1.1个百分点,在符号上下降了2.6个百分点,在范围上没有变化(95%的间隔包括零). 这些模型的方向也有所不同。 就Quen3.8 27B而言,修改范围下类别的文本比例从19.1%上升到22.0%。 即使在最高层,灵敏度仍然接近第4节中的数值,因此更多的推理并不能消除尺度灵敏度.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Scale sensitivity at three reasoning levels for the three open models. The black line is the average over the three models. Bars are 95% item bootstrap intervals from 2,000 resamples.
blocks.zh: 图10:三种开放型号在三个推理层面上的尺度敏感度. 黑线是三个模型的平均值. 栏杆是2 000个复制品的95%的靴子间隔。

blocks.en: E.2 Agreement with Human Labels
blocks.zh: E.2 人类标签协定

blocks.en: Our main analyses compare scores across rating scale conditions rather than against human labels. We additionally report how well the scores agree with the human labels of each dataset under every combination of model, prompting strategy, and rating scale condition (see Figure 11 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的主要分析是比较不同等级条件的分数,而不是比较人类的标签。 我们还报告,在模型、激励策略和评级条件的组合下,得分如何与每个数据集的人类标签一致(见图11)。

blocks.en: We select the agreement metric based on the type of human label. The sentiment labels in the VADER dataset Hutto and Gilbert (2014) and the toxicity labels in the Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification dataset cjadams et al. (2019) are continuous. They represent the mean rating across annotators for sentiment and the proportion of annotators who marked a text as toxic for toxicity. For these tasks, we report Spearman’s rank correlation between LLM-generated scores and human labels, which is unaffected by normalization to a common scale range. In contrast, the political leaning labels in MBIC Spinde et al. (2021) are categorical. They indicate whether the outlet that published each sentence is left, center, or right, based on media ratings rather than a judgment of the sentence itself. We map each LLM-generated score to the three categories used for S ​ S switch SS_{\mathrm{switch}} and report macro-F1 against the human labels.
blocks.zh: 我们根据人类标签的类型来选择协议指标。 VADER数据集Hutto和Gilbert(2014年)中的情绪标签,以及Jigsaw Uninted Bias在毒性分类数据集cjadams等人(2019年)中的毒性标签是连续的。 它们代表了对情绪的批注者的平均评级,以及标注文字有毒毒性的批注者的比例。 对于这些任务,我们报告斯皮尔曼在LLM生成的分数和人类标签之间的排名关联,这不受正常化的影响,也不受一个共同的尺度范围的影响. 相比之下,MBIC Spinde等人(2021年)中的政治倾斜标签是绝对的. 它们表明,发布每个句子的出入口是左,中,还是右,是基于媒体的评级,而不是对句子本身的判断. 我们将每个 LLM 生成的分数映射到 S S 切换 SS_{\ mathrm{switch}} 的 3 个类别,并对照人类标签报告宏-F1 。

blocks.en: Agreement with human labels varies substantially across tasks. Spearman’s correlation ranges from 0.87 to 0.95 for sentiment and from 0.24 to 0.38 for toxicity, while macro-F1 ranges from 0.34 to 0.65 for political leaning. The lower correlations for toxicity may reflect what the human labels measure, namely the proportion of annotators who considered a text toxic rather than the intensity of its toxicity. Similarly, the lower agreement for political leaning may reflect that its labels describe the outlet rather than the sentence. MBIC also includes sentences on non-political topics, and a sentence from a left- or right-leaning outlet may express no leaning of its own.
blocks.zh: 与人类标签的一致因任务而异。 斯皮尔曼的关联性在情绪0.87至0.95之间,毒性0.24至0.38之间,而宏观F1在政治倾向0.34至0.65之间. 毒性的较低相关性可能反映人类标签的衡量标准,即认为文字有毒的注释者的比例,而不是其毒性的强度。 同样,低级的政治倾向协议可能反映其标签描述的是出口而不是句子。 MBIC还包括非政治性话题的句子,从左或右向外的句子可能表示不倾斜本身.

blocks.en: Agreement also varies with rating scale design. For sentiment, 3-point ordinal scales yield the lowest correlations (0.87–0.90). For political leaning, average macro-F1 on ordinal scales decreases from 0.58 with 3 points to 0.48 with 21 points. Within each combination of model and prompting strategy, the difference between the highest and lowest macro-F1 across the 16 scales ranges from 0.09 to 0.23. Rubric-based prompting yields lower macro-F1 for political leaning than zero-shot prompting for every model and scale, averaging 0.51 compared with 0.56. For sentiment and toxicity, the average change in correlation between prompting strategies is less than 0.01.
blocks.zh: 评级等级表的设计也各不相同。 就情绪而言,3点正弦比值产生最低的关联性(0.87-0.90)。 就政治倾斜而言,名义尺度上的平均宏观-F1从0.58,3分下降到0.48,21分。 在模型和促动策略的每一种组合中,16个尺度中最高和最低的宏观F1的差别从0.09到0.23不等. 基于Rubric的促动对每个模型和尺度的政治倾斜率低于零射速率,平均0.51,而0.56。 就情绪和毒性而言,促动策略之间相互关系的平均变化不到0.01。

blocks.en: This section provides additional statistical details for the results presented in Section 4 . All analyses were conducted in Python 3.9.6 with NumPy 2.0.2 and pandas 2.3.3. We fit the weighted least squares regressions with NumPy linear algebra routines and computed Spearman correlations with SciPy 1.13.1. Figures were created with Matplotlib 3.9.4.

blocks.en: First, Table 6 reports the interaction coefficients from the weighted least squares (WLS) regression. Each sensitivity estimate is weighted by the inverse of the number of minimal pairs that vary the same design element, giving format, range, and sign equal total weight. Format is the reference level of the design element changed. Each interaction coefficient indicates how the difference in sensitivity between sign or range and format changes at a given moderator level compared with the moderator’s reference level.
blocks.zh: 首先,表6报告了加权最小方(WLS)回归的相互作用系数。 每个灵敏度估计值均以最小对数的反向加权,这些最小对数变化相同的设计元素,给出格式,范围,并签名等总重. 格式是改变的设计元素的参考水平。 每个相互作用系数都表明,与主持人的参考水平相比,特定主持人级别上标志或范围与格式之间的敏感度差异是如何变化的.

blocks.en: Table 6: Moderation of scale sensitivity by task, prompting strategy, and model. Entries are interaction coefficients b b from weighted least squares regressions of the 1,200 minimal pair estimates, fitted separately for each metric. Brackets are 95% item bootstrap intervals. Intervals that include zero indicate no detectable moderation.
blocks.zh: 表6:按任务、激励战略和模式分列的规模敏感性的中度。 条目是1,200个最小对数估计数的加权最小方程回归的相互作用系数bb,为每个计量标准分别配置。 夹子是95%的靴子间隔 包含0的间隔表示没有可检测的节制.

blocks.en: Next, Table 7 gives the full variance decomposition illustrated in Figure 5 . In the variance decomposition, scale design distinguishes all 40 minimal pairs, so it covers which design element changes, the values compared for that element, and the values of the other two elements held fixed. Because every combination of minimal pair, task, prompting strategy, and model occurs exactly once, the shares do not overlap and add up to 100%.
blocks.zh: 其次,表7列出了图5所示的全部差异分解情况。 在差异分解中,比例尺设计区分了所有40个最小对,因此涵盖了哪些设计元素变化,该元素的比较值,以及持有的另外两个元素的数值固定. 因为每一个最小对数,任务,提示策略和模型的组合都完全发生一次,所以股份并不重叠,加起来高达100%.

blocks.en: Table 7: Full variance decomposition of the 1,200 minimal pair estimates (Figure 5 ). Shares come from the weighted least squares regression with all interactions between two factors and sum to 100% for each metric. Subcomponents may not add exactly to their total because of rounding. All 95% item bootstrap intervals lie within 1.2 percentage points of the estimates.
blocks.zh: 表7:1 200个最小对数估计数的完全差异分解(图5)。 份额来自加权最小的方块回归,两个因素之间所有相互作用,每个度量的和为100%。 由于四舍五入,子部件不一定能准确增加总数。 所有95%的物品夹间隔都在估计数的1.2个百分点以内。
